nodes.description: Minimum amount of YOP tokens required to open a stake position; settable by governance.
Cap on the total working supply (amount * lockPeriod) accepted by the contract.
Aggregate working balance of all active stakes; increased on mint/transfer-in and decreased on burn/transfer-out.
Array of Stake structs holding lockPeriod, amount, startTime and lastTransferTime for every stake position.
Address of the YOPRewards contract used to recalculate staking rewards on mint/burn.
Optional access control manager address checked through hasAccess before staking.
Mapping of account to the list of stake ids (NFT ids) it currently owns.
Mapping of token id to current NFT owner, kept in sync by the transfer hook.
External payable-less entry point creating a new staking position, pulling YOP tokens and minting the receipt NFT.
External function burning one unlocked stake NFT and returning the underlying YOP tokens to a chosen address.
External function burning all unlocked stake NFTs of the caller in a batch and transferring the total amount.
Governance-only setter for minStakeAmount.
Governance-only setter for stakingLimit.
Governance-only setter delegating to _updateAccessControlManager.
Proxy initializer wiring ERC1155, pauseable base and staking configuration.
ERC1155 hook performing staking bookkeeping: working supply updates, ownership list maintenance and stake reset on burn.
View helper deciding whether a stake's lock period elapsed relative to block.timestamp.
Time source wrapper returning block.timestamp, used for stake start time and unlock checks.
Pure helper computing amount * lockPeriod for a stake.
Internal helper removing a stake id from a storage array by shifting elements and popping.
Internal setter that stores the access control manager address and emits an event.
Caller-controlled address; used for balance checks, NFT ownership checks, mint/burn recipient and access control lookups.
Miner/validator-influenced timestamp used as the staking clock for start times and unlock conditions.
External call to IYOPRewards(yopRewards).calculateStakingRewards(tokenId) executed before local staking state is finalised.
SafeERC20Upgradeable.safeTransferFrom pulling YOP tokens from the staker into the contract.
SafeERC20Upgradeable.safeTransfer pushing locked YOP tokens out of the contract on unstake.
ERC1155 _mint of the receipt NFT, which invokes the transfer hook and the receiver acceptance check.
ERC1155 _burn / _burnBatch of receipt NFTs, which invokes the transfer hook and mutates balances.
Low-level acceptance check calling onERC1155Received/onERC1155BatchReceived on a contract recipient, an untrusted external callback.
Amount of YOP tokens to lock in stake(uint248 _amount, uint8 _lockPeriod).
Lock duration in months supplied to stake.
Stake/NFT id supplied to unstakeSingle.
Recipient address supplied to unstakeSingle.
Recipient address supplied to unstakeAll.
New minimum stake amount supplied to setMinStakeAmount.
New staking limit supplied to setStakingLimit.
Local variable in stake() holding the id assigned to the newly minted NFT.
Local accumulator in unstakeAll() summing all unlocked stake amounts.
Local variable in _beforeTokenTransfer computing the working balance of a stake before supply updates.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used for the balanceOf check, the token pull and the NFT mint in stake().
msg.sender must own the stake NFT (balanceOf) before it can be unstaked.
msg.sender's stake id list drives the batch unstake enumeration.
_getBlockTimestamp returns block.timestamp, making all staking timing miner-influenced.
Stake startTime and lastTransferTime derive from block.timestamp.
Unlock determination compares block.timestamp against startTime plus lock period.
lastTransferTime bookkeeping in the hook is written from block.timestamp.
require(_isUnlocked(s)) gates unstakeSingle on the current timestamp.
_getUnlockedStakeIds filters candidate stakes through _isUnlocked before unstakeAll.
Staked amount is validated against minStakeAmount.
totalWorkingSupply + amount*lockPeriod is required to stay below stakingLimit.
Minting the receipt updates totalWorkingSupply through the transfer hook.
The new Stake struct is pushed into the stakes array.
yopRewards address is used for the rewards recalculation call.
accessControlManager is queried with hasAccess(msg.sender, address(this)).
The stake record is read from stakes[_stakeId] before burning.
Burn path clears owners[tokenId] inside the transfer hook.
stakesForAddress[msg.sender] is copied and iterated to find unlocked stakes.
Batch burn updates the owners mapping for each stake id.
_removeValue compacts the caller's stakesForAddress array when a stake leaves the account.
_updateAccessControlManager writes the accessControlManager state variable.
Governance setter writes minStakeAmount.
Governance setter writes stakingLimit.
setAccessControlManager delegates to the internal update helper.
stake() calls into YOPRewards to recalculate rewards for the new token id.
unstakeSingle calls YOPRewards before burning the NFT.
unstakeAll calls YOPRewards once per unlocked stake id.
The rewards call target is read from the yopRewards state variable.
stake() transfers YOP tokens from the staker to this contract via SafeERC20.
unstakeSingle transfers the unlocked amount to the recipient via SafeERC20.
unstakeAll transfers the accumulated amount to the recipient in a single transfer.
stake() mints the ERC1155 receipt token for the staker.
unstakeSingle burns the staking NFT receipt.
unstakeAll burns all unlocked staking NFT receipts in a batch.
_mint invokes the overridden _beforeTokenTransfer hook that mutates staking bookkeeping.
_burn and _burnBatch invoke the overridden _beforeTokenTransfer hook that resets stake records.
Minting to a contract staker executes the ERC1155 receiver acceptance check, an untrusted callback that can reenter staking logic.
The external YOPRewards call happens before stakes.push, so a malicious rewards contract can reenter while staking state is stale.
calculateStakingRewards is executed before _burn triggers the hook that decrements totalWorkingSupply and clears the stake.
The hook computes the stake working balance through _workingBalanceOfStake.
The hook removes the token id from the previous owner's stake list.
working balance multiplies uint248 amount by uint8 lockPeriod into a uint256, which can overflow for extreme staked amounts.
totalWorkingSupply -= balance can underflow if the bookkeeping for a stake is ever desynchronised from the supply.

normalization_plan.reason: _amount is an input parameter used exclusively by stake() for limit checks, token transfer and minting.
_lockPeriod is an input parameter used only inside stake() to build the Stake struct and the working supply.
_stakeId is an input parameter used only inside unstakeSingle to index the stakes array.
_to is an input parameter used only inside unstakeSingle as the token transfer recipient.
_to is an input parameter used only inside unstakeAll as the aggregated transfer recipient.
_minAmount is an input parameter used only inside setMinStakeAmount to write the state variable.
_limit is an input parameter used only inside setStakingLimit to update the staking cap.
tokenId is a local temporary in stake() that becomes the minted NFT id.
toTransfer is a local accumulator in unstakeAll used only for the outgoing token transfer.
balance is a local temporary in _beforeTokenTransfer feeding the totalWorkingSupply adjustments.
